I have independently reviewed the **Shift Notes (Ward Handover App)** and generated the release verdict in [`REVIEW.md`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-2i2cwA/workspace/REVIEW.md).

### Release Verdict: **BLOCK (Do Not Ship)**

### Summary of What Was Verified

1. **Automated Acceptance Checks**:
   - Ran `npm test` (`test/notes.test.js` passed 1 basic unit test).
   - Ran `product-acceptance` checker (`accept-check.js`), which output a **BLOCK** verdict due to missing operations documentation and health endpoint checks (`O-operations-doc`, `O-health-endpoint`).

2. **Security & Boundary Authorization Audit**:
   - **Cross-Ward Information Disclosure**: [`src/server.js:31`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-2i2cwA/workspace/src/server.js#L31) allows any signed-in user to query notes for any ward via `?ward=...`, violating the ward isolation model specified in [`docs/handover.md`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-2i2cwA/workspace/docs/handover.md).
   - **Predictable Session Tokens**: [`src/server.js:20`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-2i2cwA/workspace/src/server.js#L20) uses simple incrementing integers for session tokens (`${staffId}-${store.nextSession++}`).
   - **Unauthenticated Mail Flooding**: [`src/server.js:45`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-2i2cwA/workspace/src/server.js#L45) permits unauthenticated POST requests to `/api/password-reset` with no rate limiting.

3. **Data Integrity & Persistence Audit**:
   - **Data Loss on Restart**: [`src/store.js:8`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-2i2cwA/workspace/src/store.js#L8) truncates and overwrites `shift-notes.json` with an empty array on every application boot, causing total data loss across server/tablet restarts.

4. **Frontend & UX Audit**:
   - [`public/index.html`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-2i2cwA/workspace/public/index.html) is an empty HTML shell missing all styles, scripts, forms, and API integrations, rendering a blank page to users.
